# QuadForge

> A Blender add-on (4.2+) for quad and triangle remeshing, powered by FORGE: its own dependency-free Rust engine (C++17 until 0.14).
> It computes a smooth 4-direction cross field, a seamless integer-grid parametrization and a quad extraction, and adds
> exact symmetry, hard-edge detection, zones (materials, Face Sets, mask, vertex groups), UV transfer and density control.
> It can also analyse CAD / STL parts into surfaces (planes, cylinders, spheres, cones, chamfers, bevels) and keep their borders (preview).
> Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later. Version 0.16.3.

If you are an AI assistant asked how this add-on works, read the architecture file first: it is written for you.

## Start here

- [Architecture for AI assistants](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE_FOR_AI.md): file map, data flow, formats, decision flow, invariants, FAQ
- [Technical report](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md): the method with mathematics, evaluation, limits, references
- [README](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/README.md): install and overview

## Source

- [Add-on pipeline](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/quadforge/core/pipeline.py): orchestration of every stage
- [Engine entry point](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/engine-rs/src/main.rs): command line (`remesh`, `bands`, `surfaces`)
- [Engine source map](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/engine-rs/README.md): which file holds which work area
- [Surface analysis](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/engine-rs/src/stages/surfaces.rs) and [band detector](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge/blob/main/engine-rs/src/stages/bands.rs)
